_description: STOP zones for the orchestrator-handoff template. Used by check-agent-ingest-preservation.py to verify compression preserves the 8-section discipline, HO1-HO10 falsifier table, epistemic-tier tag vocabulary, embedded-artifact markers, and verbatim cross-references that downstream new-orchestrator chats pattern-match on. This file was recently revised by v0.8.0 (HO10 added); compress conservatively.
verbatim_required: Falsifier checklist additions for handoff prompts
_verbatim_required_rationale: Section names (8 required sections + falsifier + common-mistakes + worked-example) that the orch references. Iron-law restatement names (trainer/superset/safe-terminal/async-handoff/wei-voice) that the new orch loads on first turn. The 4 epistemic tags [verified|inferred|speculative|unknown] are the per-fact tagging vocabulary. The ===AGENT N PROMPT=== markers are how embedded prompts are located programmatically. validate-track-status.sh + status-unverified + planned-but-evidence-present are the v0.8.0 HO10 vocabulary.
_custom_id_patterns_rationale: HO1-HO10 are the handoff-specific falsifier IDs (extended to HO10 in v0.8.0 for the status-claim evidence iron law). Tier-1/Tier-2 anchor safe-terminal rule citations.
_placeholder_required_rationale: Bracketed slots the operator/orch fills in when authoring a handoff prompt.
_anchor_phrases_rationale: Cross-file path references that anchor handoff to other artifacts in the skill family and the operator's project conventions.
